reading_source: Correct answers and explanations in data/pages73.json, existing reviewed page73 inputs, and zukan vocabulary readings. All 22 part names reviewed; katakana converted to hiragana, long vowels retained. Topic は → わ, object を → お, lexical はつ/はらみ and ひょうめん preserved.
notes: Pitch dictionary searched before generation for every name. Seven food/anatomical-sense matches receive explicit targets. Four metaphorical names have candidate evidence only; eleven specialist names have no reliable exact entry. Unconfirmed names receive standard Tokyo Japanese guidance without an invented numeric accent. No audible pitch/listening verification claimed.

content_correction.description: Chicken harami is abdominal-wall muscle. The original quiz calls it diaphragm; the new card corrects that anatomy.
